project.name: Negotex Runtime API
project.description:
Shared model and interface contracts between the process compiler (ops), the runtime engine, and all adapters. Contains: - RuntimeManifest and definition model (pure data records) - EnvelopeTransport / EnvelopeTransportFactory - EnvelopeEventWriter / EnvelopeEventWriterFactory / EnvelopeEvent - CorrelationStore / CorrelationStoreFactory - Envelope record
No behaviour, no infrastructure dependencies beyond Jackson for YAML serialisation.
